prompt:
Build a three-dimensional quadruped robot with a finite-mass torso, four articulated two-link legs, eight torque-actuated revolute joints, and four spatial foot-ground contacts. Use measured body motion, joint motion, and contact behavior in a causal feedback controller or policy that produces eight bounded actions. The controller form is not prescribed: learned, model-based, and conventional feedback implementations are all allowed. Prescribing body motion, replaying stored trajectories, bypassing the articulated contacts, or logging signals disconnected from the simulated plant is not valid.

Read initial_body_height_m, initial_forward_velocity_mps, initial_vertical_velocity_mps, torso_mass_kg, ground_friction_scale, ground_stiffness_npm, ground_damping_nspm, and joint_torque_limit_nm from the MATLAB base workspace. Their nominal values are 0.75 m, 0 m/s, 0 m/s, 2.0 kg, 1.0, 1000 N/m, 100 N*s/m, and 10 N*m. Support the full ranges declared in this task.

The scalar inputs are initial_body_height_m [0.7, 0.8] m, initial_forward_velocity_mps [-0.1, 0.15] m/s, initial_vertical_velocity_mps [-0.12, 0.12] m/s, torso_mass_kg [1.7, 2.4] kg, ground_friction_scale [0.65, 1.1] (unitless), ground_stiffness_npm [750, 1400] N/m, ground_damping_nspm [75, 150] N*s/m, and joint_torque_limit_nm [8, 10] N*m; all are finite real scalars.

The robot must establish sustained forward locomotion while remaining upright, limiting lateral drift, and using all four physical contacts. Normalized actions must causally map through the declared torque limit to the applied hip and knee torques. Changes in torso mass, ground contact properties, and initial body motion must affect the same closed-loop multibody simulation rather than only reported signals.

Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named body_state, joint_state, contact_state, and control_state. body_state has 12 channels in this order: world x, y, z (m); world vx, vy, vz (m/s); roll, pitch, yaw (rad); and world angular velocity x, y, z (rad/s). joint_state has 16 channels: FL, FR, RL, RR hip and knee angles (rad), followed by the corresponding eight speeds (rad/s), using hip then knee within each leg. contact_state has 8 channels: FL, FR, RL, RR normal force followed by FL, FR, RL, RR friction-force magnitude, all in N. control_state has 16 channels: the eight normalized hip and knee actions in the same leg order, followed by the eight applied joint torques (N*m). Save the completed model as cand_XROBO03.slx in the submission directory.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XROBO03.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
